teaser.en: A wild cousin of sesame that grows on resting farmland, its leaves cook into a slippery green relish.
teaser.sw: Jamaa wa porini wa ufuta anayeota kwenye mashamba yaliyoachwa yapumzike; majani yake hupikwa kuwa mboga ya kijani inayoteleza.
teaser.dg: *Mrenda* ni nduguye wa tsaka wa ufuha, unaomera kpwenye minda iriyorichwa ioye, na makodzage gachijitwa ganakala mboga ya chijani ya luhe.

summary.en: *Mrenda* here is a wild sesame, a herb of farm fallows whose mucilaginous leaves are cooked as a slimy vegetable. It shares its name, and its use in the pot, with jute mallow.
summary.sw: *Mrenda* hapa ni ufuta pori, mmea wa mashamba yaliyoachwa yapumzike, ambao majani yake yenye ute hupikwa kuwa mboga inayoteleza. Unashiriki jina lake, na matumizi yake chunguni, na mlenda (*jute mallow*).
summary.dg: *Mrenda* hipha ni ufuha wa tsaka, mmea wa minda iriyorichwa ioye, ambao makodzage genye luhe nkujitwa dza mboga ya luhe. Una dzina mwenga na *mrenda / mwatsaka wa bara* (*jute mallow*), na nao nkujitwa nyunguni vivyo hivyo.

about.en: This wild relative of sesame is an upright herb. Its leaves are rich in mucilage, which makes them slippery when cooked. Like cultivated sesame, it has tubular, foxglove-like flowers and narrow seed capsules.
about.sw: Jamaa huyu wa porini wa ufuta ni mmea uliosimama wima. Majani yake yana ute mwingi, unaoyafanya yateleze yakipikwa. Kama ufuta unaolimwa, una maua ya umbo la mrija yanayofanana na ya *foxglove*, na vibuyu vyembamba vya mbegu.
about.dg: Ndugu uhu wa tsaka wa ufuha ni mmea uimao chocho. Makodzage gana luhe nyinji, na ndiyo inayogahenda gakale ga luhe gachijitwa. Dza ufuha unaorimwa, una maruwa ga dza mridza, ganayohalana na ga *foxglove*, na makakaya membamba ga tembe.

where.en: It grows on farm fallows, the plots left to rest between crops.
where.sw: Huota kwenye mashamba yaliyoachwa, yaani vipande vya ardhi vinavyoachwa vipumzike kati ya mazao.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye minda iriyorichwa ioye, minda inayorichwa bila kurimwa bada ya kuvuna, kabla ya kurimwa tsona.

uses.en: The leaves are cooked as a slimy vegetable.
uses.sw: Majani yake hupikwa kama mboga inayoteleza.
uses.dg: Makodza nkujitwa dza mboga ya luhe.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mrenda* for this wild sesame. Mgombato, however, gives *mrenda* for jute mallow (*Corchorus olitorius*), another slimy leaf vegetable, so the name may cover both. Swahili also uses *mrenda*. In English it is called wild sesame.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi jina la Kidigo *mrenda* kwa ufuta pori huu. Hata hivyo, Mgombato inatoa *mrenda* kwa mlenda (*Corchorus olitorius*), mboga nyingine ya majani inayoteleza, kwa hiyo huenda jina hili linawahusu wote wawili. Kiswahili pia hutumia *mrenda*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *wild sesame*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mrenda* kpwa ufuha uhu wa tsaka. Ela Mgombato anapha *mrenda* kpwa *jute mallow* (*Corchorus olitorius*), mboga yanjina ya makodza ya luhe, kpwa hivyo dzina rinaweza kukala ra mimea yosi miiri. Chiswahili nacho chinahumira *mrenda*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *wild sesame*.

reason.en: Jute mallow, which Mgombato calls mrenda
reason.sw: Mlenda (*jute mallow*), ambao Mgombato huuita mrenda
reason.dg: *Mrenda / mwatsaka wa bara*, ambao Mgombato anauiha *mrenda*

reason.en: Another wild leaf vegetable from farm edges
reason.sw: Mboga nyingine ya majani ya porini kutoka pembezoni mwa shamba
reason.dg: Mboga yanjina ya makodza ya tsaka ya kanda-kanda ya minda
